features: Karaoke in the player's three-dot menu: vocals are removed so only the instrumental plays, with a full-screen synced lyrics view and lyrics written in English letters
Up Next list is now clear liquid glass like the Home navigation bar
Player buttons, queue and Ambience no longer have outline lines; Ambience sits centered under the play row
New round liquid-glass Like and Download buttons with a pop animation
Default liquid-glass player background now has flowing, glowing wave lines
New player backgrounds: Snowland (falling snow), Tokyo (neon city lights), Fireworks and Car Drift; Blur, Glow and Gradient removed
Player background is now the first item in the three-dot menu
Player slider styles (Bar, Wavy, Slim) now work with the new player, each with its own animation
Hiding the thumbnail now shows the Pattukal app icon
SponsorBlock auto-skip and Crop thumbnail are now on by default
Music Cube is on by default and shows songs in your chosen language; pick your own six songs from its settings
Choose your music language when you first open the app; Home songs follow it while the app stays in English (change it anytime in Settings or the AI companion)
AI companion automatically tries every available source if one fails and answers faster; its settings now scroll smoothly
Appearance is now right below the AI companion in Settings
New official contact email in About
